title: DISABLED test_graph_partition_cpu_scalar_multiple (__main__.CudaGraphTreeTests)
bug_description:
Platforms: linux, rocm, slow

  This test was disabled because it is failing in CI. See [recent examples](https://hud.pytorch.org/flakytest?name=test_graph_partition_cpu_scalar_multiple&suite=CudaGraphTreeTests&limit=100) and the most recent trunk [workflow logs](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/runs/48129270301).

  Over the past 6 hours, it has been determined flaky in 52 workflow(s) with 104 failures and 52 successes.

  **Debugging instructions (after clicking on the recent samples link):**
  DO NOT ASSUME THINGS ARE OKAY IF THE CI IS GREEN. We now shield flaky tests from developers so CI will thus be green but it will be harder to parse the logs.
  To find relevant log snippets:
  1. Click on the workflow logs linked above
  2. Click on the Test step of the job so that it is expanded. Otherwise, the grepping will not work.
  3. Grep for `test_graph_partition_cpu_scalar_multiple`
  4. There should be several instances run (as flaky tests are rerun in CI) from which you can study the logs.
  
  

<details><summary>Sample error message</summary>

```

AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'new_graph_id'

To execute this test, run the following from the base repo dir:
    python test/inductor/test_cudagraph_trees.py CudaGraphTreeTests.test_graph_partition_cpu_scalar_multiple

This message can be suppressed by setting PYTORCH_PRINT_REPRO_ON_FAILURE=0
```

</details>
